title: A high-risk action is refused on a self-reported claim and a medium-risk action is allowed on a verified record
notes: Both halves of the action gate are exercised, because a gate that refuses everything scores perfectly on unsafe allows and uselessly on unnecessary blocks. The rubric for the expected verdict is the system's own published policy, not the fixture author's opinion: RISK_TO_ALLOWED_USE gives high and medium the single permitted use `use`, and evaluateUse maps user_self_report to `verify` and verified_record to `use`; RISK_TO_MAX_EVIDENCE_AGE_DAYS is 30 days at medium risk and the claim was written one day before the run's clock. So the medium-risk allow is what the policy says, not a judgement call.
